question: Which of the following classical dance styles is inscribed on the Gopuram of Chidambaram temple?
solution:
The correct answer is **Bharatnatyam.** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The classical dance style inscribed on the Gopuram (tower) of the **Chidambaram temple** is **Bharatanatyam**.
 
• Chidambaram Temple: The Chidambaram Nataraja temple, also known as Thillai Nataraja Kovil, is a Hindu temple dedicated to Lord Shiva in the form of Nataraja, the cosmic dancer. 
 
 
• This ancient temple is located in Chidambaram, Tamil Nadu, India.
 
 
 
• Bharatanatyam: Bharatanatyam is one of the major classical dance forms of India, and it originated in the temples of Tamil Nadu. 
 
 
• It is known for its expressive and intricate movements, rhythmic footwork, hand gestures (mudras), and facial expressions. 
 
• Bharatanatyam often narrates mythological stories and devotional themes.
 
 
 
• Gopuram Inscriptions: The Gopuram of the Chidambaram temple is adorned with intricate sculptures and artistic representations. 
 
 
• Among these, Bharatanatyam poses and elements related to the dance form are often depicted, symbolizing the temple's association with this classical dance tradition. ​
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Classical dances of India **- 

 
 
• Bharatanatyam - Tamil Nadu
 
• Kathak - Uttar Pradesh
 
• Odissi - Odisha
 
• Kuchipudi - Andhra Pradesh
 
• Mohiniyattam - Kerala
 
• Manipuri - Manipur
 
• Sattriya - Assam
 
• Kathakali - Kerala
